claims: From Lost to Found on the Pacific Crest Trail is a 2012 memoir by Cheryl Strayed.
Cheryl Strayed chronicled her impulsive 1,100-mile solo hike on the Pacific Crest Trail in the memoir to recover from her mother's death, drug addiction, and divorce.
The 2014 film adaptation of the memoir was directed by Jean-Marc Vallée.
Reese Witherspoon stars as Cheryl Strayed in the 2014 film adaptation.
